Text.Page:
[EN] Help me. It hurts so bad.
[ES] Ayúdame. Duele muchísimo.

[EN] Give it to me straight, friend. We're all going to die here, aren't we?
[ES] Dímelo sin rodeos, amigo. Todos vamos a morir aquí, ¿verdad?

[EN] Tell Lohra I love her.
[ES] Dile a Lohra que la amo.

[EN] I kept trying to pull people into the lifeboat, but they were so slippery, and my grip got weak.
[ES] Seguí intentando subir gente al bote salvavidas, pero estaban muy resbaladizos y mi fuerza flaqueó.
